p.title: F&G semantics gate accepts a newer intraday headline
p.symptom: main CI failed on every bot commit with 'fear-greed headline is the rounding of the latest daily point: headline=32 latest=31.23', blocking Pages deployment.
p.root_cause: CNN's same-day daily marker (00:00Z) and its intraday headline (13:51Z) are different observations (P1100 keeps the marker in history); the gate required equality whenever the calendar day matched.
p.fix: Equality is required only when the headline is not later than the daily marker.
p.violated_rule: A gate must encode the data's real observation semantics, not an assumed equality.
p.prevention: The check still fails if a same-day headline older than or equal to the marker differs from it.
